steps.name: Capture immutable qualification source inputs
steps.run:
git archive --format=tar.gz --output "$RUNNER_TEMP/dotnet-guest-source.tar.gz" HEAD -- \
  apps sdk/dotnet-guest sdk/rust examples tools crates wit schemas docs .cargo \
  Cargo.toml Cargo.lock rust-toolchain.toml LICENSE NOTICE .github/workflows/dotnet-guest.yml
test "$(stat --format=%s "$RUNNER_TEMP/dotnet-guest-source.tar.gz")" -le 134217728
git rev-parse HEAD > "$RUNNER_TEMP/dotnet-guest-source.sha"

steps.name: Retain the exact reviewed command contract input
Test contract projection, output ownership and drift rejection
Retain exact inputs and check the clock contract
steps.run:
mkdir -p "$RUNNER_TEMP/dotnet-guest"
git rev-parse HEAD > "$RUNNER_TEMP/dotnet-guest/revision.txt"
cmp wit/platform/clock/package.wit sdk/dotnet-guest/runtime/wit/deps/latent-clock.wit

steps.name: Install captured NativeAOT namespace and loader inputs
steps.run:
sudo apt-get update
sudo apt-get install --yes bubblewrap libgdbm6t64 libreadline8t64 libsqlite3-0 liblttng-ust1t64 libtcl8.6 libtk8.6
sudo sysctl -w kernel.apparmor_restrict_unprivileged_userns=0

steps.name: Install the pinned native compiler and closed runtime
steps.run:
curl --fail --location --max-time 180 \
  https://github.com/WebAssembly/wasi-sdk/releases/download/wasi-sdk-29/wasi-sdk-29.0-x86_64-linux.tar.gz \
  --output "$RUNNER_TEMP/wasi-sdk.tar.gz"
printf '%s  %s\n' 87d1d1a2879d139cdc624b968efad3d4a97b8078cdff95e63ac88ecafd1a0171 "$RUNNER_TEMP/wasi-sdk.tar.gz" | sha256sum --check --strict
tar -xzf "$RUNNER_TEMP/wasi-sdk.tar.gz" -C "$RUNNER_TEMP"
python3 tools/install_guest_bindgen.py "$RUNNER_TEMP/dotnet-authoring-bindgen"
export PATH="$RUNNER_TEMP/dotnet-authoring-bindgen:$PATH"
printf '%s\n' "$RUNNER_TEMP/dotnet-authoring-bindgen" >> "$GITHUB_PATH"
python3 tools/dotnet_capsule.py install-tools "$RUNNER_TEMP/dotnet-authoring-tools" \
  --wasi-sdk "$RUNNER_TEMP/wasi-sdk-29.0-x86_64-linux"

steps.name: Qualify proposed transaction shapes with the maintained NativeAOT compiler
Compile the authored transaction aggregate and forbidden immediate HTTP variant
Check independent editable projects and closed provenance profiles
steps.run:
python3 -m pip install -r tools/requirements.lock
python3 -m unittest tools.tests.test_dotnet_capsule_authoring tools.tests.test_build_provenance_schemas

steps.name: Preserve bounded errors in the actual captured WASI BCL
Test exact NuGet authoring and transactional review
Test captured NuGet selection and compiler isolation
Generate and independently check current typed guest bindings
steps.run:
python3 tools/install_guest_bindgen.py "$RUNNER_TEMP/dotnet-guest/tools"
python3 tools/stage_runtime_wit.py target/dotnet-binding-wit --source wit/platform/runtime-phase3-blobs
export LSF_WIT_BINDGEN="$RUNNER_TEMP/dotnet-guest/tools/wit-bindgen" LSF_WASM_TOOLS=wasm-tools
python3 tools/dotnet_guest_bindings.py c-sharp target/dotnet-binding-wit --world capsule --runtime native-aot --with-wit-results --out-dir "$RUNNER_TEMP/dotnet-guest/generated"
python3 tools/dotnet_guest_bindings.py c-sharp target/dotnet-binding-wit --world capsule --runtime native-aot --with-wit-results --out-dir "$RUNNER_TEMP/dotnet-guest/generated" --check

steps.name: Compile the actual C# probe and measure build costs
steps.run:
set -o pipefail
probe="$RUNNER_TEMP/dotnet-probe-source"
mkdir "$probe"
cp probes/smoke/Smoke.csproj probes/smoke/Operations.cs \
  probes/smoke/component.wit probes/smoke/packages.lock.json \
  global.json nuget.config "$probe/"
cd "$probe"
dotnet --info > "$RUNNER_TEMP/dotnet-guest/dotnet-info.txt"
dotnet restore Smoke.csproj --configfile nuget.config --locked-mode 2>&1 | tee "$RUNNER_TEMP/dotnet-guest/restore.log"
export LSF_WIT_BINDGEN="$RUNNER_TEMP/dotnet-guest/tools/wit-bindgen" LSF_WASM_TOOLS=wasm-tools
/usr/bin/time -f '{"wallSeconds":%e,"maxRssKiB":%M,"exitCode":%x}' -o "$RUNNER_TEMP/dotnet-guest/compilation-cost.json" dotnet build Smoke.csproj -c Release --no-restore -p:WasiSdkRoot="$RUNNER_TEMP/wasi-sdk-29.0-x86_64-linux" -p:WitBindgenExe="python3 $GITHUB_WORKSPACE/tools/dotnet_guest_bindings.py" 2>&1 | tee "$RUNNER_TEMP/dotnet-guest/build.log"
cp packages.lock.json "$RUNNER_TEMP/dotnet-guest/packages.lock.json"

steps.name: Pair private blocking I/O function types without changing original core bytes
Compose capability-constrained compiler support
steps.run:
set -o pipefail
cargo build --quiet --locked -p latent-toolchain-smoke --example dotnet-closed-runtime --target wasm32-unknown-unknown --release
wasm-tools component new target/wasm32-unknown-unknown/release/examples/dotnet_closed_runtime.wasm -o "$RUNNER_TEMP/dotnet-guest/runtime.wasm"
tools="$HOME/.nuget/packages/bytecodealliance.componentize.dotnet.wasm.sdk/0.8.0-preview00011/tools/linux-x64"
cp "$RUNNER_TEMP/dotnet-probe-source/bin/Release/net10.0/wasi-wasm/publish/Smoke.wasm" "$RUNNER_TEMP/dotnet-guest/raw.wasm"
"$tools/wac" plug "$RUNNER_TEMP/dotnet-guest/raw.wasm" --plug "$RUNNER_TEMP/dotnet-guest/runtime.wasm" -o "$RUNNER_TEMP/dotnet-guest/component.wasm"
wasm-tools validate "$RUNNER_TEMP/dotnet-guest/component.wasm"
wasm-tools component wit "$RUNNER_TEMP/dotnet-guest/component.wasm" | tee "$RUNNER_TEMP/dotnet-guest/admitted.wit"

steps.name: Validate reviewed resource-alias composer
Execute LSF authority and fresh-heap qualification
steps.run:
set -o pipefail
cargo test --quiet -p latent-wasmtime --test dotnet_guest --locked -- --ignored --nocapture --test-threads=1 2>&1 | tee "$RUNNER_TEMP/dotnet-guest/execution.log"

steps.name: Qualify captured projects, all SDK owners, enforced node and printed guide
